dataset.title: Vantor Open Data · Nepal September 2026 visual original
dataset.description: Finite integration of one actual current Vantor Open Data disaster archive visual: Nepal-Flooding-Aug-2026, original item B120001101250A10 observed on 2026-09-07. The complete publisher JPEG-compressed GeoTIFF is preserved. This does not provide commercial imagery ordering, global coverage or support for every event asset.
dataset.attribution: Vantor Open Data Program, Nepal-Flooding-Aug-2026, Legion LG02, item B120001101250A10; acquisition 2026-09-07T05:07:53.249593Z. Preserve original item and event Collection, source time, CC BY-NC 4.0 attribution and noncommercial restrictions.
dataset.nominalResolution: Original EPSG:4326 36389 × 41157 canvas, spacing 0.000005190520394450596° × 0.0000045967538055144995°. Publisher sensor pan/multispectral GSD remains separate.
dataset.valueInterpretation: TIFF stores lossy JPEG YCbCr with 2×2 chroma subsampling, not scientific red/green/blue samples. Native inspection reports JPEG-decoded UInt8 Y, Cb, Cr components on the original pixel grid; chroma is upsampled with the codec's triangular fancy interpolation. These are not the original subsampled chroma planes, calibrated reflectance or a conversion to RGB. Publisher eo:bands logical red/green/blue declarations remain unchanged and separate. Preview stretches only Y luminance in grayscale.

layers.title: Visual original · JPEG Y/Cb/Cr
layers.valueInterpretation: Complete original visual TIFF; raw pixel arrays report Y, Cb, Cr after JPEG chroma upsampling. Luminance-only grayscale display. No scientific RGB calibration, analytic-band replacement or damage assessment.

warnings: Only exact item B120001101250A10 and the independently hashed complete 29,534,465-byte TIFF are supported. Other current events and visual profiles remain unverified; unsupported requests return no replacement.
The event name contains August, but this item's actual observation instant is 2026-09-07T05:07:53.249593Z. Event date, publication and ingestion dates do not replace acquisition time.

Publisher cloud cover is 93 percent. Footprint intersection and the visual preview do not establish usable AOI coverage, cloud-free imagery or flood damage. The TIFF declares no scalar NoData: noData=false and black canvas pixels do not prove usable observations.

The original lossy JPEG components are display values. Full-resolution chroma values include codec spatial upsampling and decoder-dependent rounding; they are not lossless sensor samples or scientifically calibrated RGB bands.

collections.title: Nepal-Flooding-Aug-2026
collections.description: On August 26, 2026, a major flash flood caused by a glacier collapse struck Rasuwa District in northern Nepal after a sudden and intense surge of water entered the Bhote Koshi River from the Tibet (China) side at approximately 9:15 AM local time. The event rapidly affected the border areas of Timure and Rasuwagadhi before moving downstream towards Syabrubesi and the Trishuli River corridor.
